findings.desc: Verified cwd-dependent smoke regression: the new closure-audit assertions read docs/requirements/decisions/control-plane-proof-capability-closure-audit.md via join(process.cwd(), CLOSURE_AUDIT_PATH). Standard package execution changes cwd to packages/main, so npm --prefix packages/main run test:proof-admissibility-hardening fails with ENOENT at packages/main/docs/requirements/decisions/control-plane-proof-capability-closure-audit.md. Running node packages/main/dist/tasks/proof-admissibility-hardening-smoke.js from repo root passes, and running node dist/tasks/lifecycle-control-smoke.js from packages/main fails the same way. Anchor the audit path to the repo root/module location or make the smoke resolve both supported cwd modes.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved closure-audit smoke path resolution by walking upward from cwd until docs/requirements/decisions/control-plane-proof-capability-closure-audit.md is found. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build; npm --prefix packages/main run test:proof-admissibility-hardening; cd packages/main && node dist/tasks/lifecycle-control-smoke.js; cd repo root && node packages/main/dist/tasks/lifecycle-control-smoke.js; cd repo root && node packages/main/dist/tasks/proof-admissibility-hardening-smoke.js.

findings.desc: DONE-required stale/freshness smoke still writes synthetic command receipts without commandSpec, so the new CommandSpec evaluator turns the intended metadata-only freshness PASS into command-spec-missing[0]. This leaves stale/mismatch coverage inconsistent with the generated DONE_REQUIRED CommandSpec envelope and currently fails npm --prefix packages/main run test:done-required-freshness-smoke after build.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed done-required-freshness-smoke synthetic receipts to include the DONE_REQUIRED CommandSpec envelope/digest shape. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, npm --prefix packages/main run test:done-required-freshness-smoke, npm --prefix packages/main run test:done-required-validation-smoke, and npm --prefix packages/main run test:proof-admissibility-hardening.
